app.name: Uplift
app.tagline: Copy that converts, proven by experiments.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Start optimizing your pages in minutes.

errors.emailTaken: An account with that email already exists.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

demo.hint: No sign-up: a temporary account with a complete example project.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Each project is a page you want to convert better.

empty.title: Your projects will show up here
empty.description: Create your first project from the URL of the page you want to optimize.

projects.createDescription: Tell us which page you want to optimize. You can change this later.

hints.url: The public page whose copy you want to improve.

errors.url: Enter a public URL starting with http:// or https://

projects.deleteDescription: The project and all its data will be deleted. This cannot be undone. To just hide it, archive it instead.

stepDescriptions.elements: Pick the copy on the page you want to optimize: headlines, CTAs, benefits…
stepDescriptions.brief: Describe the brand voice, the business and the legal rules the AI must follow.
stepDescriptions.variants: Generate, review and select copy variants for each element.
stepDescriptions.goals: Define what counts as a conversion: clicks, URL visits or events.
stepDescriptions.preview: Review the page with the variants applied on desktop and mobile.
stepDescriptions.activation: Install the script on your site and launch the experiment.
stepDescriptions.results: Compare variants and find out which one converts best.

overview.detailsDescription: The AI uses the industry, page type and market to tailor the copy.
overview.statusDescription: Where the project is in the process.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

elements.title: Elements to optimize
elements.dialogDescription: An element is one specific piece of copy: a headline, a button, a benefit…

placeholders.name: e.g. Main headline
placeholders.originalText: Paste the copy exactly as it appears on the page
placeholders.notes: e.g. Keep the mention of the 14-day free trial

hints.selector: Identifies the element on the page. e.g. #hero h1, .pricing .cta-primary
hints.originalText: The starting point (the control version) for generating variants.
hints.overLimit: The original copy is over the maximum: variants will be shorter.
hints.length: Optional. Limits variant length so they fit the design.

errors.range: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum

elements.deleteDescription: Its variants will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.

empty.title: No elements yet
empty.description: Add the copy on the page you want to improve. Start with what drives conversion most: the headline and the main button.

tips.title: Prefer to type the selector?
tips.step1: Open the page in Chrome, right-click the text and choose “Inspect”.
tips.step2: In the Elements panel, right-click the highlighted node → Copy → Copy selector.
tips.step3: Paste it here and simplify it if it is very long.
tips.stable: Prefer ids or meaningful classes (#hero-title) over long :nth-child paths, which break when the page changes.

picker.title: Pick an element
picker.description: Hover over the page and click the copy you want to optimize. Links are disabled.
picker.capturingHint: We load it in a real browser so it looks just like your site. This can take a few seconds.

errors.blocked_url: The URL points to a private or disallowed address. Use the public page URL.
errors.timeout: The page took too long to load.
errors.unreachable: The page isn't responding or returns an error. Check the project URL.
errors.too_large: The page is too large to capture.
errors.rate_limited: Too many refreshes. Wait a minute.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

tagInput.hint: Type and press Enter to add. Paste several lines to add many at once.

brief.neverSaved: You haven't saved the brief yet.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.description: Your changes to the brief will be lost if you leave now.

sectionDescriptions.offer: What this page sells and what you want it to achieve.
sectionDescriptions.reader: Who the visitor is and what makes them hesitate. Variants will speak to that person.
sectionDescriptions.evidence: What you can prove and what you can't promise. The AI only quotes data from here.
sectionDescriptions.style: How your brand writes, so variants sound like your team.
sectionDescriptions.rules: Rules no variant may break. They are checked on every generation.

offer.product: E.g. Home insurance with 24/7 assistance and urgent repairs included

reader.audience: E.g. Families renting or buying their first home
reader.doubts: E.g. "The price will go up later"

style.notes: E.g. Short sentences. No jargon. We say "your home", not "the property".

rules.legalNotes: E.g. Price for a 90 m² home in Madrid. Terms apply.

offer.benefits: Why someone would pick you. One per line.

reader.doubts: What stops the visitor from acting; variants will try to clear it up.

evidence.proofPoints: Real figures, guarantees and data the AI can use as is.
evidence.offLimits: Tempting lines that can't be said.

rules.bannedWords: Separate with commas or Enter. No variant may contain them.
rules.requiredMentions: Text that has to appear when relevant.
rules.legalNotes: Legal clarifications that go with certain data (prices, returns…).
rules.avoidStyles: Ways of writing that don't fit your brand.

sensitivityDescriptions.medium: Careful claims that can be checked.
sensitivityDescriptions.high: Regulated sector: only data from the evidence section, with its small print.

regulated.title: Regulated sector
regulated.description: Advertising in {{industry}} is regulated. We recommend high sensitivity.

completeness.title: Brief quality
completeness.description: The more complete it is, the better and safer the variants.

checks.proofPoints: At least one provable data point

variants.instructionsPlaceholder: e.g. shorter and punchier, lead with the savings…
variants.empty: No variants for this element yet.
variants.qualityHint: The AI's rating: clarity, relevance and persuasiveness.

issues.banned_word: Uses “{{detail}}”, a word we don't use.
issues.off_limits_promise: Makes a promise we can't make: “{{detail}}”.

errors.alreadyRunning: A generation is already running for this project.
errors.rateLimited: Too many generations in a row. Wait a minute.

failed.description: Try again with “Generate more”. If it keeps failing, review the original copy and the brief.

demo.title: Demo mode
demo.description: No Claude API key is configured, so variants come from sample templates. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to use the real AI.

weakBrief.title: The brief is thin
weakBrief.description: With more context about the business and brand, the variants will be much better.

noElements.title: Add elements first
noElements.description: Variants are generated for the copy you mark as elements on the page.

variants.rulesHint: Automatic review of words we don't use, promises we can't make and length.

goals.title: Conversion goals
goals.description: Which visitor action counts as a conversion in the experiment.
goals.dialogDescription: Define how we detect that a visitor converted.

kindHints.click: When a button or link is clicked.
kindHints.pageview: When a page is reached, e.g. the “thank you” page.
kindHints.event: When your site sends a custom event.

hints.eventName: Letters, numbers, dashes, dots or colons.

errors.regex: The regular expression is not valid

test.label: Try a URL
test.match: This URL counts as a conversion
test.noMatch: This URL doesn't count as a conversion

goals.deleteDescription: It will no longer be measured in experiments.
goals.deletePrimaryDescription: It's the primary goal: the next oldest goal will become primary.

empty.title: No goals yet
empty.description: Without a goal there's no way to tell which variant wins. Start with the page's most important action.

primaryHelp.title: Primary goal
primaryHelp.description: The metric that decides the winning variant. Secondary goals are measured too, to catch side effects.

preview.notFoundHint: The selector doesn't match this element in the current snapshot.

noSnapshot.title: No snapshot of the page yet
noSnapshot.description: We load the page in a real browser to show you how the variants look.

hints.draft: Set up the versions and launch it when ready.
hints.paused: No new traffic is assigned while paused.

checks.variantArm: At least one version changes an element and gets traffic

errors.no_primary_goal: Set a primary goal before launching the experiment.
errors.no_variant_arm: At least one version must change an element and get traffic.
errors.invalid: Check the settings: some values are not valid.

finish.title: Finish the experiment?
finish.description: Measuring stops. If you pick a winning version, the script will show it to every visitor from now on.

resetConfirm.title: Reset the experiment?
resetConfirm.description: All collected data will be deleted and it goes back to draft so you can change the versions.

arms.title: Versions
arms.description: Each column is a version of the page. Choose which variant each element shows and how traffic is split.
arms.locked: Versions can't change while the experiment is live. Reset it to edit them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Where the experiment runs and how many people it reaches.
settings.trafficHint: The rest see the original page and don't count in the results.
settings.timeout: Show the page after at most
settings.domainsHint: The script only acts on these domains. Use *.domain.com for every subdomain.
settings.hidePageHint: Briefly hides the page until the variant is applied, so the original copy never flashes.

install.title: Installation
install.description: Paste this code in the page <head>, as high as possible.
install.testPageHint: A copy of the page with the script installed, to try the experiment out.

toasts.applied: Winner applied: every visitor will see it

notStarted.title: The experiment hasn't started
notStarted.description: Launch it from Activation to start collecting data.

finished.title: Experiment finished
finished.original: Every visitor sees the original page.

collecting.title: Collecting data
collecting.description_one: A decision needs at least {{count}} visitor per version and 95% certainty.
collecting.description_other: A decision needs at least {{count}} visitors per version and 95% certainty.

winner.title: “{{name}}” is the winner
winner.description: {{probability}} probability of being the best, with an estimated lift of {{lift}}.

control.title: The original performs better
control.description: Control has a {{probability}} probability of being the best version.

noDifference.title: No clear difference
noDifference.description: At this traffic level no version stands out. Try bolder changes.

beatsControl.title: Several versions beat the original
beatsControl.description: {{names}} convert better than control with 95% certainty, but it's not yet clear which is best.

table.title: Results
table.noGoal: Set a primary goal to see results.

chart.title: Cumulative conversion rate
chart.caption: Each point is the cumulative rate up to that day. It usually settles over time.
chart.notEnough: The trend appears once there are at least two days of data.

secondary.title: Secondary goals
secondary.description: To catch side effects: a version can win on the primary goal and hurt others.

simulation.title: Demo mode: simulate traffic
simulation.description: Generates 14 days of simulated, reproducible visits so you can see results without installing the script on a real site. Kept apart from real data.
simulation.needsLive: Launch the experiment to simulate traffic.

demoBanner.text: You're in a demo account: data is deleted after 24 hours.

library.title: Library
library.description: Copy that won experiments and variants you saved, ready to reuse.

empty.title: Your library is empty
empty.description: Variants that win experiments and the ones you save from the variants screen will show up here.

use.title: Use in a project
use.description: It will be added as a new variant of the element you choose.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Your account, your organization and how copy is generated.

toasts.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How others see you and which language you use Uplift in.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs out every other device.
password.wrong: That isn't the password you use now
password.demo: Demo accounts don't have a password.

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: Projects belong to the organization and are shared by all its members.
organization.name: Name
organization.invitesSoon: Inviting new members is coming soon.

ai.title: AI generation
ai.mock: Demo mode: variants come from sample templates. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY on the server to use Claude.
ai.claude: Claude ({{model}}) with structured outputs and a rules review on every variant.

waking.title: Waking up the server…
waking.body: This demo runs on a free plan that sleeps when idle. It takes about a minute to start.
